# TRICHOMONAS VAGINITIS

Male sexual partners of women with trichomonas vaginitis will not have symptoms but should be treated to prevent recurrent vaginitis in the female sexual partner.

## Diagnosis

The discharge is purulent, malodorous, and thin. The vaginal pH is greater than 4.5. Nucleic Acid amplification test (NAAT) for trichomonas has improved sensitivities and specificities compared to wet mount.

Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment of Initial Episode WOMEN ONLY (See below for MEN)

Pregnant women with trichomonas infection may be treated with metronidazole during any trimester.
Metronidazole 2 gm PO once ($) [DI]
< OR >
Metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days ($) [DI]

### Treatment of male sex partners

### Persistent or recurrent infection in symptomatic women or male sex partners
Metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days ($) [DI]

## Outpatient

### Treatment of Initial Episode WOMEN ONLY (See below for MEN)

Pregnant women with trichomonas infection may be treated with metronidazole during any trimester.
Metronidazole 2 gm PO x 1 dose ($) [DI]

### Treatment of Initial Episode MEN ONLY (See above for WOMEN)

### Treatment of male sex partners
Metronidazole 2 gm PO x 1 dose ($) [DI]

2nd failure:
Metronidazole 2 gm PO q24h for 7 days ($) [DI]
